name: astro-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for solo hobby projects.

plugins.name: show-work
plugins.description: A pane where Claude shows its plan, decisions, assumptions, questions and the files and commands it touches.

plugins.name: inline-thinking
plugins.description: Draws Claude's thinking in the chat, above the reply or tool call it led to, in place of the folded "Thought for 4s".

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: Gates that refuse risky Bash commands (pkill, kill by pattern, git add -A, git commit -a) and tell Claude why and what to run instead.

plugins.name: global-memory
plugins.description: Memories Claude writes for every project, kept in ~/.claude/memory and loaded into each session.

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Toggle on and each task Claude takes on goes into a git worktree named for it, removed once the work is merged or the session ends and nothing in it would be lost.
